name: speech-to-text
description: Transcribe local audio and video files into speaker-separated text, with an explicit fully-local or current-model-polished output choice.
description_cn: 将本地音频或视频转成带说话人标签的文字，并由用户选择完全本地输出或交给当前模型润色。

presentation.summary: 本地识别音视频，分离说话人，并按选择生成原始稿或 AI 润色稿。
examples: 转录会议录音并区分说话人
把 M4A 语音转成文字
本地转录，不要把正文交给云端 AI
presentation.access_note: 音频始终由本地模型处理；只有选择 AI 润色时，转录文字才会交给当前模型。

workflow: Ask whether the user wants fully local raw output or current-model AI polishing before transcription.
Require the verified speech-to-text component, then call transcribe_audio with the explicit polish choice and speaker diarization enabled by default.
For local-only output, report the generated path without reading the transcript back into model context.
For AI polish, preserve speaker labels and timestamps, then call save_transcript_result.
If polishing cannot be completed reliably, show the raw transcript and promote the local raw file as the final result.
